mapper.select: SELECT cm.comment_id, cm.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, cm.content, cm.created_at FROM comments cm LEFT JOIN users u ON cm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE cm.album_id = #{album_id} ORDER BY cm.comment_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE album_id = #{album_id}
